relation_statement: Universal-checkpoint state saved from a stage-3 run with multiple parameter subgroups must be restored bit-identically after reload, without out-of-bounds tensor slicing or write races corrupting shard files.
observable_signal: checksum of parameter/optimizer state before save vs after load; corrupted or truncated checkpoint shard files
validity_precondition: ZeRO stage 3 with multiple parameter subgroups; universal checkpoint save with multiple writer processes
evidence_from_issue: stage3 universal checkpoint 未正确处理多 subgroup 场景，tensor slicing 越界
evidence_from_fix: 多进程同时写入同一 checkpoint 文件导致竞争条件和数据损坏

relation_statement: The gradient accumulation buffer must keep a high-precision (fp32) dtype independent of the model weight dtype when training in BF16 under ZeRO.
observable_signal: dtype of the gradient accumulation buffer at accumulation time (bf16 instead of fp32); drift of accumulated gradients vs fp32-accumulated reference
validity_precondition: BF16 mixed-precision training with ZeRO gradient accumulation
evidence_from_issue: ZeRO 各 stage 强制梯度累积使用与模型权重相同的 dtype
evidence_from_fix: BF16 训练时梯度在 BF16 精度下累积导致数值不稳定

relation_statement: The number of saved model-state checkpoint files must match the number of tensor-parallel ranks (one shard per TP rank) when saving an MoE checkpoint with TP>1.
observable_signal: count of model_states files on disk vs TP world size; missing shards for TP ranks > 0
validity_precondition: MoE model checkpoint save with tensor parallelism enabled
evidence_from_issue: MoE checkpoint 保存仅保留 rank 0 的 model_states 文件
evidence_from_fix: TP > 1 时其他 TP rank 的数据缺失

relation_statement: The checkpoint's optimizer-state layout must match the actually configured optimizer mode (no ZeRO-partitioned state when ZeRO is disabled) under bf16 training without ZeRO.
observable_signal: mismatch between checkpoint optimizer-state layout/metadata and the runtime optimizer configuration at load time
validity_precondition: bf16 training with ZeRO disabled; checkpoint save/load path
evidence_from_issue: bf16 without ZeRO incorrectly treated as having ZeRO optimizer state in checkpoint
evidence_from_fix: root_cause field empty; inferred from title only

relation_statement: Frozen (requires_grad=False) parameters must be excluded from the trainable fp16 partitions and from optimizer state under ZeRO stage 3.
observable_signal: checksum of frozen parameters changing across optimizer steps; frozen parameters present in optimizer (Adam) state
validity_precondition: ZeRO stage 3 and model contains parameters with requires_grad=False
evidence_from_issue: ZeRO3 builds fp16 partitions from full param_groups including frozen params ... unused optimizer state
evidence_from_fix: Frozen params became part of the partitioned trainable list — they were placed into Adam fp32 state and received update increments from optimizer.step, silently un-freezing them.

relation_statement: The fp16 overflow decision and loss-scale state must be equal across all data-parallel ranks at every step under ZeRO stage 1, so parameters remain replicated.
observable_signal: loss_scale value and step-skip flag compared across DP ranks; parameter checksums diverging across DP ranks after overflow events
validity_precondition: fp16 with dynamic loss scaler and ZeRO stage 1; some step where only a subset of ranks observes gradient overflow
evidence_from_issue: ZeRO-1 fp16 overflow flag broadcast only on partition_gradients path — Z1 ranks diverge on overflow
evidence_from_fix: the cross-rank all_reduce of overflow was skipped for stage 1 ... ranks have different loss_scale values and different parameter values — DDP-equivalence is broken

relation_statement: The gradient read by the wrapped optimizer's step must be cast to fp32 before the update when grad_accum_dtype is bf16 under BF16_Optimizer.
observable_signal: dtype of param_partition.grad at optimizer.step entry (bf16 instead of fp32); precision loss in Adam second-moment statistics
validity_precondition: bf16 model with BF16_Optimizer and grad_accum_dtype set to bf16
evidence_from_issue: BF16_Optimizer skips fp32 cast of gradient when grad_acc_dtype != fp32 — Adam runs on bf16 grads
evidence_from_fix: nothing converts it to fp32 before the wrapped Adam.step() reads it. Adam then computes m_t, v_t, and the parameter update entirely in bf16

relation_statement: Each parameter's low-precision gradient must be accumulated into the fp32 gradient buffer exactly once per backward pass on non-last pipeline stages when immediate grad update hooks are enabled.
observable_signal: fp32 accumulated gradient equal to 2x the low-precision gradient (ratio hp_grad/lp_grad = 2) on PP non-last stages
validity_precondition: pipeline parallelism with BF16_Optimizer and bfloat16_immediate_grad_update=True; non-last pipeline stage backward
evidence_from_issue: PipelineEngine non-last-stage backward double-updates hp_grads when bfloat16_immediate_grad_update is enabled
evidence_from_fix: the unconditional call to update_hp_grads then adds lp.grad to the fp32 accumulator a SECOND time — every gradient on PP non-last stages is doubled

relation_statement: Padding elements of the gradient reduce-scatter buffer must be zero so the reduced partition conserves exactly the sum of true per-rank gradient contributions under ZeRO stage 3 when the last partition requires padding.
observable_signal: nonzero values in the padding region of the communication buffer before reduce_scatter; received gradient partition differing from the sum of true per-rank gradients
validity_precondition: ZeRO stage 3 and some parameter whose last partition is smaller than partition_numel (padding required)
evidence_from_issue: ZeRO-3 partition padding allocated with torch.empty — undefined values get reduced into other ranks' partitions
evidence_from_fix: the trailing pad elements held arbitrary garbage ... other ranks received contaminated padding bytes mixed into the next parameter's region

relation_statement: The gate weight tensor used in the router forward must remain the same object registered with the distributed optimizer (no rebinding to a fresh copy) under ZeRO with fp16/bf16 downcast.
observable_signal: router gate weight checksum constant across optimizer steps while its gradient is nonzero; forward-used weight tensor identity differing from the optimizer-registered parameter
validity_precondition: MoE layer with a top-k gate, fp16/bf16 mixed precision, ZeRO stage 1/2/3 (engine downcasts model parameters)
evidence_from_issue: TopKGate.wg silently rebound to a fresh fp32 Linear under ZeRO+fp16/bf16 — gate weight gradients never applied to the ZeRO-managed parameter
evidence_from_fix: creates a brand new Linear whose weight is a fresh fp32 copy ... the original (ZeRO-managed) wg.weight stays at its initialization value forever; only the orphan copy receives gradient updates that get thrown away

relation_statement: The dQ/dK/dV gradients produced by attention backward must be invariant to the context-parallel degree (match single-device values) when context parallelism is enabled.
observable_signal: relative error of attention activation gradients vs a CP-disabled (single-card) reference run (observed up to 1.2)
validity_precondition: attention modules with context parallelism enabled
evidence_from_issue: dQ, dK, dV output from the backward function of core_attention are wrong when context parallelism is enabled
evidence_from_fix: Activation gradients have relative error as large as 1.2 compared to single-card training

relation_statement: Backward-pass loss scaling must use the chunk's local loss without multiplying by cp_size, so gradients match non-CP training when context parallelism is enabled.
observable_signal: gradient magnitude ratio between CP and non-CP runs equal to cp_size instead of 1
validity_precondition: context-parallel training; backward pass loss scaling logic
evidence_from_issue: Loss is multiplied by cp_size in the backward pass, causing gradient outputs to differ from non-CP training
evidence_from_fix: The mul cp_size logic should be removed; gradients should use the chunk's local loss, not the all-reduced loss

relation_statement: The multi-token-prediction loss must be divided by num_tokens (per-token averaged) before backward when calculate_per_token_loss is set.
observable_signal: gradient norm explosion; auxiliary loss magnitude scaling with token count instead of being per-token normalized
validity_precondition: multi-token-prediction loss is a tensor and calculate_per_token_loss is set
evidence_from_issue: failing to divide by num_tokens results in mtp_loss.sum().backward() instead of per-token averaging
evidence_from_fix: causing gradient explosion and incorrect training

relation_statement: A bucket's parameter all-gather must complete before any of its parameters are consumed by the forward pass when --overlap-param-gather is enabled and bucket order differs from forward execution order.
observable_signal: parameter version/checksum read in forward matching the previous step's weights instead of the post-update values
validity_precondition: distributed optimizer with --overlap-param-gather; parameter bucket order differs from model forward execution order
evidence_from_issue: all-gather hasn't completed for a bucket before its parameters are used in forward
evidence_from_fix: The previous step's weights are used, producing incorrect results

relation_statement: The frequency of overflow-detected (skipped) steps must match the frequency of actual gradient overflow events when fp16 loss scaling is combined with overlapped grad-reduce and param-gather.
observable_signal: found_inf_flag true on every step while gradients are finite; learning rate pinned at zero; parameter checksums constant across steps
validity_precondition: --fp16 with loss scaler, --use-distributed-optimizer, --overlap-grad-reduce and --overlap-param-gather enabled together
evidence_from_issue: found_inf_flag stays true causing learning rate to remain at zero. Training loop runs but no meaningful learning occurs
evidence_from_fix: All-gather handle list in DistributedOptimizer not properly initialized ... makes FP16 loss scaler always detect inf, setting LR=0 and skipping all parameter updates

relation_statement: Attention outputs must be invariant to the sequence-parallel degree, requiring q/k/v to be all-gathered to the full sequence before flash attention when sequence parallelism is enabled.
observable_signal: attention output divergence vs an SP-disabled reference; effective attended sequence length equal to L/sp_size instead of L
validity_precondition: sequence parallelism enabled together with Flash Attention
evidence_from_issue: q/k/v tensors are not all-gathered before flash attention. Attention is computed only on L/sp_size chunk instead of full sequence
evidence_from_fix: causing model to stop attending to previous content beyond the chunk boundary

relation_statement: The rotary-embedding positions applied to each token must equal the supplied position IDs when --reset-position-ids is used.
observable_signal: rotary phase index used per token vs the provided position_ids tensor (0..seq_len-1 applied regardless of resets)
validity_precondition: --reset-position-ids enabled (packed sequences with per-document position resets); RoPE positional encoding
evidence_from_issue: RoPE always uses positions 0 to seq_len-1 instead of the actual position IDs
evidence_from_fix: Rotary embeddings do not account for enc_position_ids, producing incorrect positional encodings

relation_statement: The router expert-bias buffer registered as fp32 must retain fp32 dtype through forward and gradient finalization when training with bf16/fp16 module conversion.
observable_signal: dtype of the expert-bias buffer at forward and finalize_model_grads (bf16 instead of fp32); loss of small-rate bias updates
validity_precondition: MoE with top-k router, --moe-router-enable-expert-bias, and --bf16/--fp16 module conversion
evidence_from_issue: expert_bias buffer is registered as fp32 but silently cast to bf16 during forward pass and finalize_model_grads
evidence_from_fix: Float16Module converts all registered buffers to bf16/fp16 ... causing precision loss in routing decisions

relation_statement: Router gating weights must receive nonzero gradients through non-degenerate routing probabilities when top-k routing with k=1 uses post-topk softmax.
observable_signal: router weight gradient norm exactly zero at every step; routing probability constantly 1.0 for the selected expert
validity_precondition: MoE with num_experts >= 2, --moe-router-topk 1, default post-topk softmax (no pre-softmax)
evidence_from_issue: Megatron applies topk first then softmax ... produces different routing decisions
evidence_from_fix: topk-then-softmax with k=1: softmax of single value is always 1.0, producing zero gradient for the router. Router weights never learn

relation_statement: The effective max_lr/min_lr used by the scheduler must equal the newly supplied values when --override-opt_param-scheduler is set at checkpoint load.
observable_signal: logged learning rate following the old checkpointed schedule instead of the overridden schedule after resume
validity_precondition: checkpoint load with --override-opt_param-scheduler and new LR parameters supplied
evidence_from_issue: the get_lr method still retrieves max_lr/min_lr from param_group (old values), ignoring the override
evidence_from_fix: LR scheduler state persists incorrectly

relation_statement: Optimizer and RNG state must be restored exactly at checkpoint resume so the first post-resume forward loss equals the loss of the uninterrupted run.
observable_signal: loss deviation at the first forward pass after resume compared to the continuous (non-resumed) run
validity_precondition: checkpoint resume (observed on mcore-0.12 vs v0.11)
evidence_from_issue: Checkpoint resume in mcore-0.12 cannot reproduce the same loss in the first forward pass, with large loss deviation compared to v0.11
evidence_from_fix: Likely caused by optimizer state or RNG state not being fully restored

relation_statement: CUDA RNG states must be equal across data-parallel replicas (and distinct across model-parallel ranks) after manual seed initialization, so dropout masks are consistent with the parallel layout.
observable_signal: RNG state / dropout mask comparison across ranks within DP groups and across TP groups
validity_precondition: model-parallel CUDA manual seed initialization; modules using parallel RNG (e.g. dropout)
evidence_from_issue: Docstring claims RNG states should be same across DP groups but different across MP groups
evidence_from_fix: the tensor_model_parallel_seed derivation may not match documentation, causing incorrect dropout behavior

relation_statement: Embedding weight-gradient computation must complete before the gradient all-reduce in pipeline-parallel schedules so the reduced gradient includes the final wgrad contribution.
observable_signal: all-reduced embedding gradient missing the final wgrad contribution (mismatch vs a synchronously computed reference); shared-embedding grad disagreement across stages
validity_precondition: pipeline-parallel schedules with (shared) embedding weight gradient computation
evidence_from_issue: embedding weight gradient computation finishes after gradient all-reduce has already occurred
evidence_from_fix: the all-reduced gradient does not include the final embedding wgrad contribution

relation_statement: Expert parameters must remain equal across replicas in the expert data-parallel group, requiring their gradients to be reduced in that group under the distributed optimizer.
observable_signal: expert parameter checksums diverging across expert-data-parallel ranks over training steps; expert main_grad buffers absent from tracked grad buffers
validity_precondition: MoE (num_experts >= 2) with --use-distributed-optimizer and data_parallel_size >= 2
evidence_from_issue: expert parameters store main_grad in discrete buffers not tracked by model.grad_buffers ... expert weights are never updated
evidence_from_fix: no gradient all-reduce in the expert data parallel group. Each rank updates expert params with local-only gradients, causing params to diverge across ranks

relation_statement: The attention softmax scaling factor must be computed from the all-dimension scale variable (mscale_all_dim) per the MLA specification for multi-head latent attention modules.
observable_signal: computed softmax_factor constant compared against the specification-derived value (requires reference implementation; no anomaly is raised at runtime)
validity_precondition: multi-head latent attention (MLA) with yarn-style scaling enabled
evidence_from_issue: uses wrong scaling variable (mscale vs mscale_all_dim) for softmax_factor calculation
evidence_from_fix: No error is thrown but attention scaling is mathematically incorrect, diverging from DeepSeek-V3 reference

relation_statement: The tensor shapes declared for pipeline p2p communication must equal the actual context-parallel-sharded activation shapes (sequence dimension divided by cp_size) when PP and CP are combined.
observable_signal: shape mismatch between the declared p2p buffer and the activation actually produced/consumed at stage boundaries
validity_precondition: pipeline-parallel schedules with context parallelism enabled
evidence_from_issue: get_tensor_shapes() in schedules.py doesn't account for context parallel size
evidence_from_fix: producing wrong tensor shapes for p2p communication between pipeline stages when CP is enabled

relation_statement: The router input must retain the model compute dtype (bf16/fp16) after input-jitter multiplication, requiring the jitter noise to be created in the input dtype.
observable_signal: dtype of the router input after jitter application (silently promoted to fp32)
validity_precondition: MoE with top-k router, --moe-input-jitter-eps > 0, bf16/fp16 mixed precision
evidence_from_issue: MoE router input jitter computation uses wrong dtype, causing numerical inconsistencies in expert routing
evidence_from_fix: torch.distributions.uniform.Uniform creates fp32 tensors by default ... multiplying bf16 input by fp32 jitter silently promotes the result to fp32

relation_statement: Master weights must be created directly in params_dtype so their initial values equal the source parameters without intermediate-cast precision loss at initialization.
observable_signal: elementwise difference between the master weight and the source parameter immediately after initialization
validity_precondition: mixed-precision training with master (high-precision) weight copies at model init
evidence_from_issue: Master weights are initialized by first creating in one dtype then casting, instead of directly using params_dtype
evidence_from_fix: The unnecessary casting introduces numerical precision loss during initialization

relation_statement: Parameter initialization must complete (stream-synchronized) before DDP copies parameter values into its buckets at model init.
observable_signal: bucket contents differing from initialized parameter values; garbage/NaN statistics in DDP buckets; cross-rank parameter divergence at step 0
validity_precondition: DDP initialization running in a separate CUDA stream from parameter initialization
evidence_from_issue: DDP copies parameter values into buckets before initialization completes, capturing garbage or partially-initialized data
evidence_from_fix: DDP initialization runs in a separate CUDA stream from parameter initialization without proper synchronization

relation_statement: The stored sample index must equal the source document index without integer truncation for all samples during index construction on long-horizon datasets.
observable_signal: negative or wrapped sample_idx values; break in monotonic growth of sample indices once the int32 range is exceeded
validity_precondition: long training runs with short-sentence datasets where doc_idx_index exceeds the int32 range
evidence_from_issue: doc_idx_index (int64) is assigned to sample_idx (int32) ... silent integer overflow produces wrong data indices
evidence_from_fix: feeding incorrect training samples

relation_statement: The rotary sine/cosine values assigned to each context-parallel rank must correspond exactly to that rank's assigned global sequence positions.
observable_signal: per-rank RoPE angles vs the global position-to-rank mapping; output divergence vs a CP=1 reference run
validity_precondition: RoPE positional embeddings with context-parallel sequence chunking
evidence_from_issue: RoPE position embedding split logic for context parallel may not correctly assign sine/cosine values to each CP rank
evidence_from_fix: the reshaping of embeddings by sequence length doesn't properly account for the distributed sequence chunks

relation_statement: Gradients must be invariant to torch.compile being enabled (match the eager-mode reference) even when requires_grad switching triggers the recompile limit in RL-style loops.
observable_signal: gradient difference between compiled and eager execution; recompile-limit hit followed by silently wrong gradients through the broadcast collective
validity_precondition: torch.compile-d model in a PPO-style loop with requires_grad state switching; collectives (c10d broadcast) inside the graph
evidence_from_issue: requires_grad state switching causes torch.compile to hit recompile limit. This breaks the autograd graph
evidence_from_fix: c10d::broadcast_ without registered autograd kernel leads to silently incorrect gradients
